questions.stem: Onion bulb appearance on nerve biopsy is seen in:
questions.solutionHtml:
Chronic inflammatory demyelinating neuropathy
  • Onion bulb appearance on nerve biopsy is a characteristic feature of chronic inflammatory demyelinating neuropathy (CIDP).
  • The onion bulb appearance is seen on nerve biopsy due to the presence of multiple concentric layers of Schwann cells around the nerve fibers.
  • This is a result of the process of demyelination and remyelination that occurs in CIDP. 


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 1231
